messages:
maya: hey everyone — I'm Maya (joined today, infra SWE). Trying to sign into Google Workspace but Okta forces me to enroll MFA and when I scan the QR in Okta Verify it says 'Unable to verify device' and then 'Unexpected error'. Anyone seen this before? @jamal :wave:

it-bot: Created ticket IT-2029 for @maya — an IT engineer will respond soon. If this is blocking your onboarding, run `/pager jamal` to escalate.

jamal: hey @maya, welcome! quick Q: what phone/OS are you on and are you using Okta Verify or trying to add a TOTP in 1Password? Also can you paste the exact error text? A couple quick tries: open an incognito window, or try manual setup instead of scanning.

maya: macOS Ventura on my laptop, iPhone 12 (iOS 16). Using Okta Verify. Error reads: 'Device activation failed (400)'.

jamal: ok — try these steps, they usually fix it:

1) Remove any previously-registered MFA devices: avatar -> Settings -> Extra verification -> remove old devices.
2) Open the SSO portal: https://redwood.okta.com and sign in again.
3) When prompted for MFA choose Set up -> Okta Verify -> if QR scan fails, choose "Manual Setup" and paste the shared secret into Okta Verify.
4) As a fallback, add the OTP into 1Password (we issue org invites) — if you add OTP there you can still sign in.

If helpful, here's the sequence I usually paste for folks:
```
1) Go to https://redwood.okta.com
2) Click your avatar -> Settings -> Extra Verification -> Remove old device
3) Sign out, sign in again -> Multifactor -> Set up -> Okta Verify
4) If QR fails, click "Can't scan?" -> Copy secret and use Manual Setup
5) In 1Password: New Item -> Password -> Add one-time password -> scan QR or paste secret
```

If manual setup still errors, DM me a screenshot and I'll reset your MFA from the admin console and check Device Trust rules.

ashley: welcome @maya! :tada: After you get SSO access please complete the "Security Basics" course in Learn@Redwood within 48 hours. Watch for the 1Password org invite (check spam).

chris: once your email is active ping me — I'll add you to the GitHub team and dev channels. also if you're blocked on repo access mention this thread.

it-bot: Ticket IT-2029 updated by jamal. Estimated ETA: 30m for reset.

maya: followed jamal's manual setup and then used 1Password to add the OTP. Verified sign-in and Gmail is working now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: :tada:
